verdict.rationale: Built-in development-time accessibility warnings are a fair axis for a React web framework, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions accessibility linting, a11y warnings, or any dev-time accessibility checks. The cited docs cover streaming, routing, styling, optimizations, and an MCP endpoint, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get built-in accessibility warnings during development instead of relying on separate audit tools
